hero.subtitle: A haven in the forest designed to nurture the well-being of every visitor.

invitation.quote: To relax, feel and explore your body from a place of joy and wonderment.
paragraphs: Amara Moon is a family run retreat sanctuary nestled in the leafy heart of Hout Bay, one of Cape Town's most breathtaking coastal valleys. Cradled between beautiful ancient mountains, indigenous fynbos and the Atlantic Ocean, it is a place where nature invites you to slow down, breathe deeply and reconnect with yourself. Every corner of Amara holds a different medicine, depending on what your nervous system needs on any given day.

We offer a peaceful 30m2 yoga studio with stereo sound system and props. An outdoor forest deck perfect for nature classes for a boogie under the stars. A kitchenette, nature's dining room, saltwater cold pool, sauna, hot tub and fire pit. Amara Moon is dedicated to offering meditative nature experiences, yoga classes, ceremonies and a range healing arts.

Come to practice, to teach, to rest or simply sit on the deck and watch the light move across the valley. Its an ideal place to host your own private group for the day, join a class in community or self retreat. Whatever it is, we are here to support you along your journey of self-discovery and nervous system reset, although the forest does most of that work.

legend.paragraph: Legend has it that where the oceans meet, the land holds a rare and powerful energy. Surrounded by the constant movement of wind, water, earth and sky, many who visit the Cape describe an immediate sense of peace, grounding and belonging... as though they have finally come home.
legend.closingQuote: It is within this extraordinary landscape that Amara Moon offers a sanctuary for transformation, where every experience is inspired by the wisdom of the towering trees that stretch skyward like yogis in a permanent upward salute.

teachInvitation.heading: We are inviting experienced teachers to join our community!
teachInvitation.paragraph: Yoga, movement modalities, sound journeys, breathwork and bodywork - for a regular slot in the shala, a once-off workshop, or a private retreat with the whole property.
